what: A DRY_RUN pass of scripts/provision-sharepoint-fields.browser.js against the tenant, run by the operator from a SharePoint page on 2026-09-02. It creates nothing. It is recorded because a dry run that reads every list is a complete reading of the estate's column state, and this one confirms two things that had been standing on inference.
source: operator's browser console output, pasted verbatim into the session

noVerifyRun.why: A DRY_RUN pass reads every column in the specification and creates nothing, so it is itself the stronger form of a verify pass: it cannot mask an incomplete estate by quietly finishing the job.

theOneOutstandingColumn.action: set DRY_RUN = false at the top of the script and paste again

whatThisConfirms.claim: OTP_Transactions.OTP_Code, .Expires_At and .Is_Verified exist in the tenant
whatThisConfirms.wasRecordedAs: capturedState LIVE on a strong inference — the deployed Web - OTP Verify writes them and the flow is saved, and Power Automate validates every item/<Column> against the connector operation at save time and refuses the flow otherwise.
whatThisConfirms.nowEstablishedBy: a direct read of the list's fields: all three reported present. The inference is retired; this is a reading.

whatThisConfirms.claim: All five declared index targets are indexed
whatThisConfirms.wasRecordedAs: APPLIED_UNVERIFIED — the 2026-08-31 apply pass set three and found two already indexed, and its verify pass re-read all five.
whatThisConfirms.nowEstablishedBy: a second, independent read on a later date: Portal Rate Limits.Title, Portal Verification Proofs.Title, Portal Support Cases.Title, Global Tracking Queue.RefIDD and DGO DIGITAL OPS.RefIDD all already indexed, 0 to set, 0 unreadable. The provisioning half of ITEM-23 is confirmed twice over.

whatThisConfirms.claim: The operator's account can write to every site the specification names
whatThisConfirms.wasRecordedAs: unstated — the script warns that Manage Lists is needed on each of the four sites and that a missing permission fails only that site.
whatThisConfirms.nowEstablishedBy: 0 sites unreachable and 0 lists unreadable across DGO_ECM_GOVERNANCE, Global_Digital_Documents_Centre, NEDMS and NITDADGO-EAAACTIVITYTRACKING. contextinfo is a POST, so reaching it also exercises the write path's authentication.

whatThisDoesNotClose: ITEM-39 — nothing was created. This run establishes that exactly one column is missing and that the account can create it; the apply pass has not been made.
ITEM-23 — the index requirement is confirmed, but its remaining criterion is live traffic: one assignment and one flag write against a known reference returning 200. Neither has been exercised.
ITEM-2 — no flow was called. This is a SharePoint REST read, not a Power Automate execution.

notedInPassing.observation: Portal OTP Codes (3f85213c-1fdc-4be0-8c0c-e28aa77fbe56, Global_Digital_Documents_Centre) already carries its own Attempts column, present.
notedInPassing.why_it_is_not_a_conflict: It is a different list on a different site. The OTP verify flow this estate patches writes to OTP_Transactions on NITDADGO-EAAACTIVITYTRACKING. The two are not addressed interchangeably anywhere — every write in the specification and in the flow definitions is by list GUID.
